_comment: FLUX.2 multi-reference scene composite defaults. Edit this file to tune generation - no Java
change and no recompile of logic is needed, and these become the values a UI would show as
defaults rather than constants buried in SWUtil.
The MODEL is deliberately NOT here. Checkpoint names are per-deployment (the local GTR9 Swarm
and the DGX Spark have disjoint checkpoint lists), so the model comes from configuration:
the olio.sd.config 'flux2Model' field, else 'sd.default.model' (Service7 init-param /
Console7 + test resource.properties), else the olio.sd.config schema default.
Per-book overrides still win over everything here: olio.sd.config's flux2Cfg / flux2Steps /
flux2Width / flux2Height / flux2ReferenceSize / flux2IncludeLandscapeRef.
Baselines from aiDocs/imageComposite.md plus measurement on 2026-08-07:
cfgScale  1.0-3.5 for an edit/reference model. Do NOT use the SDXL cfg (5-7).
steps     DEPENDS ON THE CHECKPOINT, not on aiDocs/imageComposite.md's 20-28 - that range is
for Flux Kontext / Flux.2 dev. flux2Klein_9b is DISTILLED and runs correctly at ~4
steps, which is also far faster; do not 'correct' it upward. A non-distilled flux2
checkpoint does want 20-28. Match the step count to the model in flux2Model.
size      landscape/3:2 preferred for two-person scenes; 1024x768 matches the classic pipeline.
refSize   every reference is encoded into the model's context, so this and includeLandscapeRef
are the two real speed levers. MEASURED on the Strix Halo iGPU, ~40s PER REFERENCE at
1024px / 4 steps: 2 refs ~80s, 3 refs ~120s. That is LINEAR in reference count at this
scale - an earlier comment here claimed superlinear growth, which the measurement
disproved. (At 24 steps the same 3-ref request took 706s, so steps dominate.)
negativePrompt: blurry faces, deformed, extra people, mismatched lighting, low quality
_initImageCreativityNote: Reserved. The multi-reference path attaches references as promptImages and sets NO init image,
so this value is inert there - it is honored only if a caller supplies an init image, which the
picture-book and chat composite paths do not. Kept configurable so it is available if a future
img2img-style FLUX.2 variant is added; do not read its presence as 'denoise is being applied'.
